item.title: District Electoral Divisions - 01 April 1957
item.description: NI District Electoral Divisions as they stood for the 1957 Stormont election. Not yet digitised: no distinct 1957 NI DED boundary set is currently available. This entry previously served the 1930 NI DED dataset as a proxy on the basis that the boundaries had not changed materially; it is now listed as to-be-added rather than served, so that an unchanged map is not mistaken for evidence of unchanged boundaries. For the 1930 boundaries see ded-1930-04-01.
